usedFor: 100Hires tracks candidates and applications, and “Create Candidate” then “Move Application to Stage” keep your pipeline current.

bestTemplate.name: “Move Application to Stage” in 100Hires
bestTemplate.why: It moves an application to the pipeline stage you select, so each candidate's status stays accurate.

watchOut: “Send Email to Candidate” reaches someone outside, so it waits in Needs you until you approve it.
